closed_world_assumption.statement: Pair coupling assumes group membership is known and that each group contains exactly one vulnerable member.
closed_world_assumption.source: benchmark construction (paired vulnerable/fixed rows share a pair_key)
closed_world_assumption.consequence: A constrained decoder must not be compared directly against an unconstrained baseline; the constraint itself carries part of the delta.

group_structure.policy: constraint applied only to groups of exactly two rows (observable without labels)

unconstrained_model.description: router row-level predictions; no group constraint

constraint_only_random.description: random orientation inside each pair; constraint only (null)

constraint_only_structural.description: semantics-free net LINE-count rule ranked inside each pair

constraint_only_char_structural.description: semantics-free net CHARACTER-count rule ranked inside each pair (strongest control)

constrained_model.description: router probabilities ranked inside each pair

headline: The model must be compared against the STRONGEST semantics-free control, not the weakest. Against the character-count rule the model shows no reliable advantage.
statistics_note: All intervals are clustered bootstraps over pair_key groups, the independent units. Previous intervals resampled five overlapping split seeds of one frozen prediction set.
